title: behold ask demo narration
description: What the ask demo page plays (behold#1163): a load turn, then question turns, each recorded from one real behold mcp ask call against an estate on emulators. scripts/ask-demo/record.ts writes it (just ask-demo-record). Nothing in it is read again when the page plays.

$schema.description: This schema's path, relative to the narration.

format.description: The format and its version. A change that breaks a reader changes the number.

recordedAt.description: When the recording finished, as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp. The page shows its date.

note.description: One paragraph for the page: this is a recording of a run on emulators, and what the estate was. It never says the answers are live.

recordCommand.description: The command that records this file again, run from a behold checkout.

agentCommand.description: How the recorder started behold's MCP server, the way a coding agent would (behold mcp --url <serve>).

versions.description: The versions the recording ran with: behold's own, the chant the served project installed, and the engines.

turns.description: The load turn first, then at least three questions, in the order the page plays them.

source.description: One source behold loaded into the graph, as the answer stamped it.

scopeKey.description: The source's scope: chant/<member>, engine/<engine>/<estate>, or cloud/<substrate>/<scope id>/<digest> for an index version.

source.description: What kind of read it is: a chant member's declared graph, an engine's graph document, an index version, or a raw cloud listing.

name.description: What produced it: chant, choudoufu, chant-lister.

readAt.description: When behold read the source, ISO 8601.

observedAt.description: When the source read the world, ISO 8601; null for a declared source, which reads no cloud.

id.description: A stable id: load, or the question's id in scripts/ask-demo/questions.ts.

kind.description: load: the person asks the agent to load the estate. question: one question about it.

prompt.description: The person's words to their agent, written for the demo.

reading.description: A question turn: one line in which the agent says how it reads the prompt, before it calls behold. The page types it between the prompt and the busy line. Optional so that files recorded before it existed still validate; the load turn has none.

call.description: What the agent ran. A question turn: the behold mcp ask tool and its arguments, exactly as sent (params and inputs are JSON strings). The load turn: the behold commands that filled the estate's graph, in order, with paths relative to the recording's scratch directory.

arguments.description: Either cypher (with params), or resource with template (and inputs).

busy.description: The busy line the prompt pane shows while the call runs.

cypher.description: The Cypher behold ran: the query as sent, or a template's expansion (its query, with the node as $key). null on the load turn, which runs no query.

params.description: The query's parameters: those sent with cypher, or the template's ($key is the node it resolved to).

columns.description: The answer's columns, in order. The load turn's are scopeKey, source, name, nodes and edges.

rows.description: The answer's rows, as behold returned them, one object per row keyed by column. Never empty on a question: a question whose answer is empty is dropped. The load turn's rows are the sources GET /api/graphdb listed.

keys.description: The graph database keys the answer names (a column named key, or a Resource node): what the /graph pane draws. They include indexed cloud and cluster objects, which the estate graph has no card for.

light.description: Node ids in the estate graph (GET /api/graph, the export's opening view) to light as the reply prints. Each answer key, and each string cell of the rows, that is a card's id, or the id of a resource folded into a stacked card (attrs._stackOf), gives that card. May be empty when the answer is only indexed objects. The load turn lights every card.

draw.description: What the /graph pane drew for the answer: the answer's nodes and the edges among them, as GET /api/graphdb answered.

sources.description: Every source the graph held when the call answered, each with its readAt and observedAt.

reply.description: The agent's reply: a template written for the demo, with every number and name filled from this turn's rows (fillReply in scripts/ask-demo/narration.ts).

headline.description: behold#1198: one plain line above the answer saying what was found, a template written for the demo with every number and name filled from this turn's rows (fillReply). A question turn may carry one; the page shows a count line without it.
